meta.topic: 旅行Vlog · 西班牙 · 龙达

scenes.title_cn: 开场：悬崖之上的天空之城
scenes.title_en: Opening: The Sky City on a Cliff
scenes.context: 博主介绍龙达：建在百米悬崖之上的古城，现代西班牙斗牛的发源地，传说中最适合私奔的小镇。语域：纪录片旁白开场。
sentences: 那里是建在百米悬崖之上的古城。
That's an ancient city perched on a hundred-meter cliff.
perched on（建在…之上）；a hundred-meter cliff（百米悬崖）
悬崖之上的天空之城，现代西班牙斗牛的发源地。
A sky city on a cliff — and the birthplace of modern Spanish bullfighting.
sky city（天空之城）；the birthplace of（…的发源地）；bullfighting（斗牛）
传说中最适合私奔的小镇。
The town legend says is perfect for eloping.
perfect for eloping（适合私奔）；legend says（传说中）
paraphrase: 建在悬崖上 → perched on a cliff / built on the edge of a cliff
perched on · built on the edge
适合私奔 → perfect for eloping / ideal for a runaway romance
perfect for eloping · runaway romance
scenes.speak: That's an ancient city perched on a hundred-meter cliff. A sky city on a cliff — and the birthplace of modern Spanish bullfighting. The town legend says is perfect for eloping.

scenes.title_cn: 从马背到肉搏：斗牛的演变
scenes.context: 博主讲解最早的西班牙斗牛是骑马持长矛、贵族的特权，从龙达这个斗牛场开始变成老百姓与牛贴身肉搏，后成职业表演。语域：历史讲述。
sentences: 最早的西班牙斗牛是像这样子，骑在马背上然后用长矛进行的，并且是贵族的特权。
Early Spanish bullfighting was done on horseback with lances, and it was a privilege of the nobility.
on horseback（骑在马上）；a privilege of the nobility（贵族的特权）
就是从这个斗牛场开始，变成了老百姓跟牛贴身肉搏。
It was from this very bullring that it became ordinary people fighting the bull hand-to-hand.
this very bullring（就是这个斗牛场）；hand-to-hand（贴身肉搏）
然后才慢慢地变成了一种职业表演。
And only later did it gradually become a professional performance.
gradually become（慢慢变成）；professional performance（职业表演）
paraphrase: 贵族的特权 → a privilege of the nobility / reserved for the aristocracy
privilege of the nobility · reserved for
贴身肉搏 → hand-to-hand / at close quarters
hand-to-hand · at close quarters
scenes.speak: Early Spanish bullfighting was done on horseback with lances, and it was a privilege of the nobility. It was from this very bullring that it became ordinary people fighting the bull hand-to-hand. And only later did it gradually become a professional performance.

scenes.title_cn: 木匠罗梅罗的意外发现
scenes.context: 关于从马背变成肉搏有两种说法，博主讲了一个木匠罗梅罗的故事：看到贵族摔下马要被牛杀死，脱下红衣把牛引开，意外发现用布引牛可行。语域：讲故事。
sentences: 有一个叫罗梅罗的木匠，她当时看到一个贵族从马背上摔下来，快要被牛给杀死了。
There was a carpenter named Romero who saw a nobleman thrown from his horse, about to be killed by the bull.
thrown from his horse（从马上摔下来）；about to be killed（快要被杀）
她随手脱了自己的红衣外套，然后把牛给引开了。
He whipped off his own red coat and lured the bull away.
whip off（随手脱掉）；lure the bull away（把牛引开）
意外发现，这每一间楼梯都画的是关于斗牛的不同的话。
And it turned out that every flight of stairs here is painted with a different scene of bullfighting.
it turned out（意外发现）；a flight of stairs（一段楼梯）
paraphrase: 快要被杀死 → about to be killed / on the verge of death
about to be · on the verge of
把牛引开 → lure the bull away / distract the bull
lure away · distract
scenes.speak: There was a carpenter named Romero who saw a nobleman thrown from his horse, about to be killed by the bull. He whipped off his own red coat and lured the bull away. And it turned out that every flight of stairs here is painted with a different scene of bullfighting.

scenes.context: 博主妈妈问斗牛是不是必须杀死牛，博主说有极小概率牛可以被赦免：表现不屈坚韧，全场举白手帕请愿，斗牛师做出有能力杀死它的空刺动作。语域：知识科普+对话。
sentences: 刚刚我妈妈问我，斗牛是不是必须要杀死那个牛。
My mom just asked me whether bullfighting always ends with the bull being killed.
whether ... always ends with（是不是总是以…结束）
有一种非常非常小的概率，这个牛是可以被赦免的。
There's a very, very small chance the bull can be pardoned.
a very small chance（非常小的概率）；be pardoned（被赦免）
全场的观众举白手帕请愿，当场的评判认为值得被赦免。
The whole crowd waves white handkerchiefs in appeal, and the judges on site decide the bull deserves a pardon.
wave white handkerchiefs（举白手帕）；deserve a pardon（值得被赦免）
paraphrase: 被赦免 → be pardoned / be spared
be pardoned · be spared
举白手帕请愿 → wave white handkerchiefs in appeal / plead with white hankies
wave handkerchiefs · plead with
scenes.speak: My mom just asked me whether bullfighting always ends with the bull being killed. There's a very, very small chance the bull can be pardoned. The whole crowd waves white handkerchiefs in appeal, and the judges on site decide the bull deserves a pardon.

scenes.title_en: The New Bridge & a Familiar Stranger
scenes.context: 博主逛龙达新桥，遇到一个一直对她说「很高兴再次见到你」的大叔，原来他们在塞维利亚的阿尔卡萨碰过面。语域：英语对话实录。
sentences: 我刚刚遇到一个大叔，他一直对着我说：很高兴再次见到你。
I just met this guy who kept telling me: nice to meet you again.
nice to meet you again（很高兴再次见到你）
然后他又说了好几遍，我还是没反应，他说：我昨天见过你。
He said it several more times and I still didn't react, until he said: I saw you yesterday.
I saw you yesterday（我昨天见过你）；didn't react（没反应）
桥的中央是一小间石室，曾经被用来关押重刑犯。
In the middle of the bridge is a small stone chamber that once held serious convicts.
a small stone chamber（一间石室）；held serious convicts（关押重刑犯）
paraphrase: 很高兴再次见到你 → nice to meet you again / great to see you again
nice to meet again · great to see again
没反应 → didn't react / drew a blank / had no idea
didn't react · drew a blank
scenes.speak: I just met this guy who kept telling me: nice to meet you again. He said it several more times and I still didn't react, until he said: I saw you yesterday. In the middle of the bridge is a small stone chamber that once held serious convicts.

scenes.title_cn: 结尾：海明威的私奔小镇
scenes.context: 博主介绍龙达「私奔小镇」称号的来源：作家海明威曾写道，如果来西班牙度蜜月或私奔，龙达是最适合的小镇。语域：文化引用+收尾。
sentences: 这就是社交媒体上大家所谓的私奔小镇。
This is the so-called eloping town everyone on social media talks about.
the so-called eloping town（所谓的私奔小镇）
因为有一位作家叫海明威，曾经写过一段话。
Because a writer named Hemingway once wrote these words.
a writer named Hemingway（一位叫海明威的作家）
如果你要来西班牙度蜜月或者和情人私奔，那龙达是最适合的小镇。
If you come to Spain for a honeymoon or to elope with your lover, then Ronda is the most suitable town.
honeymoon（度蜜月）；elope with your lover（和情人私奔）；the most suitable town（最适合的小镇）
paraphrase: 所谓的 → the so-called / what people call
the so-called · what people call
度蜜月 → honeymoon / go on a honeymoon
honeymoon
scenes.speak: This is the so-called eloping town everyone on social media talks about. Because a writer named Hemingway once wrote these words. If you come to Spain for a honeymoon or to elope with your lover, then Ronda is the most suitable town.

practice: Ronda is a cliff-top town, the birthplace of bullfighting, and the town for eloping.
The bull can be pardoned if the crowd waves white handkerchiefs and the judges agree.
The chamber in the middle of the bridge once held serious convicts.
引用海明威的话介绍龙达
Hemingway said Ronda is the best town to elope to in Spain.
pitfalls: I very happy to see you again.
Nice to meet you again / Great to see you again.
I very happy 缺少 be 动词；地道问候用 Nice/Great to see you again。
The bull is killed by force.
赦免用 pardon/spare，不是「被迫」；语义相反。
Ronda is a city on the cliff.
Ronda is perched on a cliff.
perched on 比 on 更能表达「建在悬崖边缘」的悬空感。
The bridge in the middle has a room.
In the middle of the bridge is a small stone chamber.
倒装句 In the middle ... is ... 是更自然的描述句式。
shifts: 说历史只会 long time ago
用 in the early days、from this very bullring、it turned out that ...（意外发现）
用 there's a very small chance、highly unlikely、rarely
用 perfect for eloping、ideal for、the most suitable town
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：豆牛→斗牛、罗美罗→罗梅罗、新墙→新桥、铁身肉搏→贴身肉搏、阿尔卡萨→塞维利亚王宫 等
